name: The Floodpits
description: A dripping cool region where Dawn hopes to find the Benefactors.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
description_citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter explains razorkin from the Floodpits track sound and that fighting one head-on would lose.
timeline.quote: The ones you find in the Floodpits aren't used to hearing sounds not echoed through water.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Dawn travels through the Mutemoors toward the Floodpits to seek the Benefactors.
timeline.quote: She had heard rumors the Benefactors would be found there.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A glitch ghost reaches for Dawn from a shard of glass; her shock wand shatters it as the battery dies.
timeline.quote: She aimed her shock wand at it and pressed the button that should increase the voltage

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The ghost shatters just as the wand's battery expires, leaving Dawn defenseless.
timeline.quote: the ghost shattering into a million specks of light even as the battery crackled and expired

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Survivors pull Dawn into a disused theater and welcome her to the Benefactors.
timeline.quote: We heard you'd been looking for us.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Benefactors take her wand to install fresh batteries and Dawn feels safe, though City's words echo.
